description_en: Queries chat records for the industry edition
name: TaskCallChats

parameters.help_en: The task ID in the decision system. This parameter can be left empty. At least one of the following parameters must have a value: taskId, agentId, or agentTag. If multiple values are specified, the query is performed based on the following priority: taskId > agentId > agentTag. Only the parameter with the highest priority is used for the query
parameters.help_zh: 决策系统中的任务编号，可以为空，其中：taskId、agentId、agentTag必须一项有值；如果传多个值，以taskId > agentId > agentTag 优先级查询。只查1次优先值
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. This parameter can be left empty. At least one of the following parameters must have a value: taskId, agentId, or agentTag. If multiple values are specified, the query is performed based on the following priority: taskId > agentId > agentTag. Only the parameter with the highest priority is used for the query
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，可以为空；其中：taskId、agentId、agentTag必须一项有值；如果传多个值，以taskId > agentId > agentTag 优先级查询。只查1次优先值
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the agent in your business system, which is used to query the corresponding agentId. This parameter can be left empty. At least one of the following parameters must have a value: taskId, agentId, or agentTag. If multiple values are specified, the query is performed based on the following priority: taskId > agentId > agentTag. Only the parameter with the highest priority is used for the query
parameters.help_zh: 建议填写坐席在贵司业务系统唯一标识，用于查询对应agentId；可以为空；其中：taskId、agentId、agentTag必须一项有值；如果传多个值，以taskId > agentId > agentTag 优先级查询。只查1次优先值
parameters.name: agent_tag

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 0 indicates that the request was successful
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回0表示请求成功

FromNumber.description_en: The speaker number. The value 0 indicates the robot
FromNumber.description_zh: 说话号码，其中0为机器人

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:
true: Successful.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
